title: Find Proteins of Unknown Function Using Plantannot - Protocol C
author: Marcos Viana
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bf88jrzw

steps.title: Open Plantannot result page
steps.instruction: Navigate to the Plantannot result page with empty filters using the URL https://www.machado.cnptia.embrapa.br/plantannot/find/?q= (or open the Plantannot home page and click the empty search magnifying glass).

steps.title: View Filters panel
steps.instruction: Observe the "Filters" card on the left side of the page.

steps.title: Select organism filter
steps.instruction: In the "Organisms" filter, expand the list with the green arrow, select the desired organism (e.g., Oropetium thomaeum) or leave all boxes empty to select all, then click "apply". The page URL will become https://www.machado.cnptia.embrapa.br/plantannot/find/?q=&selected_facets=organism%3AOropetium+thomaeum.

substeps.instruction: Expand organism list using the green arrow.

steps.title: Select feature type
steps.instruction: In the "Feature type" filter, choose "polypeptide" and click "apply". The URL updates to https://www.machado.cnptia.embrapa.br/plantannot/find/?q=&selected_facets=organism%3AOropetium+thomaeum&selected_facets=so_term%3Apolypeptide.

steps.title: Select orthology filter
steps.instruction: In the Orthology filter, select "orthology" and click "apply". The URL updates to https://www.machado.cnptia.embrapa.br/plantannot/find/?q=&selected_facets=organism%3AOropetium+thomaeum&selected_facets=so_term%3Apolypeptide&selected_facets=orthology%3A1.

steps.title: Select co‑expression filter
steps.instruction: In the "Orthologs_coexpression" filter, choose "co-expression" and click "apply". The URL updates to https://www.machado.cnptia.embrapa.br/plantannot/find/?q=&selected_facets=organism%3AOropetium+thomaeum&selected_facets=so_term%3Apolypeptide&selected_facets=orthology%3A1&selected_facets=orthologs_coexpression%3Atrue.

steps.title: Select analyses filters
steps.instruction: In the "Analyses" filter, check both "no diamond matches" and "no interproscan matches", then click "apply". The URL becomes https://www.machado.cnptia.embrapa.br/plantannot/find/?q=&selected_facets=organism%3AOropetium+thomaeum&selected_facets=so_term%3Apolypeptide&selected_facets=orthology%3A1&selected_facets=orthologs_coexpression%3Atrue&selected_facets=analyses%3Ano+diamond+matches&selected_facets=analyses%3Ano+interproscan+matches.

steps.title: View results list
steps.instruction: Observe the "Results" card on the centre‑right of the screen; the list now shows Oropetium thomaeum PUFs associated with abiotic stress via orthology and co‑expression networks. The final URL is https://www.machado.cnptia.embrapa.br/plantannot/find/?q=&selected_facets=organism%3AOropetium+thomaeum&selected_facets=so_term%3Apolypeptide&selected_facets=orthology%3A1&selected_facets=orthologs_coexpression%3Atrue&selected_facets=analyses%3Ano+diamond+matches&selected_facets=analyses%3Ano+interproscan+matches.
